acip: SHES BYA DANG SHES PA LA RANG BZHIN GYIS YOD MED KYI KHYAD PAR MED PAR STON PA YIN LA, SKRA SHAD MED NA DER SNANG BA'I SHES PA YANG MED CES PA DANG, SGYU MA LA RTA GLANG DU ZHEN PA'I ZHEN YUL MED NA DER 'DZIN PA'I SHES PA YANG MED CES SOGS NI, SLOB DPON 'DI'I LUGS GTAN MIN NO,,
english: What this is indicating is that there is no difference between knowable things and the awareness which knows them, as far as existing through some nature of their own, or not. And what this is saying is that—if there is no strand of hair—then neither is there any state of mind which is taking that strand as its aspect. It is absolutely not the position of this master though to say that—if the object that one was thinking was there when we perceived a horse or cow in an illusion didn't really exist—then the state of mind that was grasping to it didn't exist either.
